newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark offers initial one bln DKK in 4 pct bill.
newsitem.headline: Denmark offers initial one bln DKK in 4 pct bill.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Tuesday that it would offer an initial one billion crowns in its new four percent three-year treasury bill, at an opening price to be set when it goes on auction at 1000 GMT.
Should the initial offer not be taken up during the first 30 minutes, the bank said, it reserved the right to remove the offer from the match system.
It added that it was prepared to offer up to a total of three billion crowns during the day. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
